1\. The gate passes checks from the wrong app 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
required_contexts() discards the app_id attached to required checks, and check_checks()
matches results by context name alone. When a different app reports a successful check with that
name on HEAD, the gate can pass even though the configured app has not reported its required check.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description Required check configurations can specify a GitHub App, but the gate drops that identity and accepts a same-named result from another app. ## Fix Focus Areas - room.py[2194-2212] - room.py[2238-2255] - tests/test_gate.py[1079-1140] ## Recommended Fix Preserve each required check's app ID and compare it with the reporting check run's app ID when evaluating required checks. Do not let a same-named result from another app satisfy an app-specific requirement; add a regression test for that case. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
